hypothesis: Explicit known-paper routing makes unchanged base Qwen use search_paper instead of guessing offsets or scanning sections linearly.
expected_signal: All five runs call search_paper before passage; at least four submit; at least three answerable runs cite gold evidence; identical tool actions are not repeated; semantic quality does not regress from the original v2 smoke.
decision_rule: Keep the routing prompt only if all runs use search_paper, at least four submit, at least three answerable runs reach gold evidence, and semantic review finds no regression from the original base smoke. Otherwise treat search routing as an SFT target and do not claim the prompt fixed it.
